abstract_state: a collection of items, each containing jumbled letters plus an extra letter, with categorical metadata
abstract_action: use category information as a constraint to identify which anagram each jumbled item represents, then determine the extra letter
abstract_next_state: a list of correctly identified words and their corresponding extra letters

abstract_state: a set of scrambled letter sequences, each associated with a category constraint
abstract_action: unscramble each sequence into a word matching the category, then extract the remaining uncategorized letter
abstract_next_state: a list of category-matching words paired with their extracted letters

abstract_state: a list of phrases, each containing a word from a target category and additional text
abstract_action: identify words matching a category, extract a specified letter from the non-category text in each phrase, and collect the extracted letters
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted letters corresponding to each phrase

abstract_state: a set of items categorized by type, where each item is associated with a source word or phrase
abstract_action: for each item in a target category, extract a specified letter from its associated source (identified by position or external reference), then combine the extracted letters with the item
abstract_next_state: a collection of item-letter pairs that serve as solutions or answers

abstract_state: a set of clues, each containing a primary word and a secondary word in parentheses; a category filter to identify relevant clues
abstract_action: for each clue matching the category filter, extract a specified word from the primary clue, then extract a single letter from the secondary word (by position or rule), then concatenate the extracted letters
abstract_next_state: a sequence of letters derived from the secondary words, which forms a hidden message or answer

abstract_state: a set of clue phrases, each containing a target word from a reference category plus additional text
abstract_action: locate the target word within each clue phrase, then extract a specified letter from the non-target portion of the phrase to form a sequence
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted letters that spell out or encode a solution

abstract_state: multiple categorized groups, each containing information with extraneous characters mixed in
abstract_action: extract the extra/surplus characters from each category and collect them into strings
abstract_next_state: a set of strings, one per category, containing only the extracted characters

abstract_state: a set of categories with associated items, and a set of numbers that need to be interpreted
abstract_action: use each number as a positional index into the name of each category to extract a letter
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted letters that spell out a hidden message

abstract_state: a sequence of extracted letters in order
abstract_action: concatenate the letters sequentially to form a string
abstract_next_state: a final answer string

abstract_state: a set of pictures with associated blanks, and a constraint that captions are song titles with one letter missing
abstract_action: for each picture-blank pair, determine the song title that fits the blanks when one letter is removed
abstract_next_state: a list of song titles (each missing one letter) that serve as captions and fill the blanks

abstract_state: a visual image with symbolic elements that suggest a concept or phrase
abstract_action: interpret visual symbols and their metaphorical meanings to decode a target phrase, then identify which letters are missing from that phrase
abstract_next_state: a decoded phrase with identified missing letters

abstract_state: a set of objects/images with identified names
abstract_action: concatenate the names of the objects, then recognize the result as a familiar phrase with a letter substitution (one letter replaced with another)
abstract_next_state: identification of the original phrase and the missing/substituted letter

abstract_state: a set of visual elements with identified meanings
abstract_action: combine the interpreted meanings into a phrase, then identify a known reference (song/phrase) with a missing element
abstract_next_state: the reference phrase with a notation of which letter/element is absent

abstract_state: an image containing visual elements that reference multiple entities or concepts
abstract_action: identify the referenced entities, recognize a familiar phrase or title that contains all of them, and note what is missing or incomplete from that phrase
abstract_next_state: a caption or answer phrase derived from a well-known work, with a component identified as missing

abstract_state: visual elements arranged spatially (image of person + image of object)
abstract_action: read the concatenated names/labels of the spatial elements, then identify which letter is missing from the resulting phrase
abstract_next_state: a phrase with an identified missing letter that reveals a title or answer

abstract_state: an image depicting a visual concept
abstract_action: identify the concept represented by the image, map it to a word, then remove a specified letter from that word
abstract_next_state: a word with one letter removed

abstract_state: visual elements depicting objects and a modified phrase/caption
abstract_action: interpret visual elements as substitutions or removals from a well-known phrase; identify missing element and reconstruct the original phrase
abstract_next_state: the original unmodified phrase or title

abstract_state: an image containing visual elements and a caption with missing or altered letters
abstract_action: identify the visual content, map it to a known reference (song/phrase/title), recognize that the caption is a homophone or sound-alike version with specific letters missing, and determine which letters are absent
abstract_next_state: the missing letters that were omitted from the reference phrase

abstract_state: an image containing visual elements and a partial caption with a missing letter
abstract_action: identify the visual pun or rebus (object used in unexpected way), recognize the phrase it represents, then determine which letter is missing from the known phrase
abstract_next_state: the missing letter identified

abstract_state: an image containing visual elements; a caption phrase with one or more letters missing
abstract_action: identify what the visual elements represent; interpret the caption as a modified version of a known phrase or song title; determine which letter(s) are absent from the caption
abstract_next_state: knowledge of the missing letter(s) and confirmation of the underlying phrase or title

abstract_state: an image with visual elements and a caption describing those elements
abstract_action: identify a missing phonetic component by comparing the caption to a known phrase or song title
abstract_next_state: the missing component extracted from the phrase/title

abstract_state: a visual composition containing multiple symbolic elements (image components)
abstract_action: interpret each visual element as a word or concept, concatenate them into a phrase, then identify missing letters by comparing to a known reference (song title)
abstract_next_state: a string with identified missing letters

abstract_state: a collection of captions, each with one or more missing letters identified
abstract_action: read the missing letters in sequential order across all captions
abstract_next_state: a string formed by concatenating the missing letters in order, which represents the final answer

abstract_state: two sets of clues positioned on opposite sides of a puzzle grid
abstract_action: identify pairs of clues that share a common semantic element; extract the shared element from each pair
abstract_next_state: a list of shared elements (common words) that bridge clue pairs

abstract_state: a set of paired items and a spatial structure (grid/pattern)
abstract_action: identify shared attributes between pairs, draw connections between them, overlay the resulting lines onto a reference structure
abstract_next_state: a visual overlay of connection lines on the reference structure that reveals a message or pattern

abstract_state: a collection of elements or data that can be read or interpreted sequentially
abstract_action: read or interpret the elements in order to form a recognizable word or phrase
abstract_next_state: a complete word or phrase that matches the expected answer

abstract_state: a grid with cells and puzzle instructions defining valid path rules
abstract_action: construct a path that satisfies all constraints and covers the maximum scope (all cells)
abstract_next_state: a complete path through the grid following the rules

abstract_state: a set of visual elements with an ordered sequence (a track) and associated text at various positions
abstract_action: traverse the longest/most prominent sequence and extract text at specific positions along that sequence
abstract_next_state: a message or string formed by concatenating the extracted text in traversal order

abstract_state: a sequence of positions along a path, each with an associated visual element, and a specific directional viewpoint
abstract_action: traverse the sequence in order and extract elements visible from a designated directional perspective at each position
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted elements that form the final answer

abstract_state: a collection of images, each containing a visual outline shape and an internal object, plus a list of target answer words
abstract_action: decompose each image into two components (outline and internal element), identify the word for each component, then perform a word insertion operation where the internal element's word is spliced into the middle of the outline word's letters
abstract_next_state: a set of new composite words formed by the insertion operation, which can be matched against the target answer words

abstract_state: a set of variable-length sequences (snack words) that combine with fixed elements (shapes) to produce outputs
abstract_action: identify a consistent surplus element that appears in every combination, correlate it with flavor text hints about excess/overconsumption
abstract_next_state: knowledge that one specific element is redundantly provided across all combinations and can be extracted as a signal

abstract_state: a set of word pairs (word A, word B) where word B is embedded within word A with one letter marked/extracted
abstract_action: for each pair, identify the marked letter in the embedded word, then extract that letter and append it to a result string
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted letters that form a final answer

abstract_state: a set of items with extraneous/marked elements interspersed throughout
abstract_action: identify and extract the marked/extra elements in their original order
abstract_next_state: a string formed by the concatenated extracted elements that spells a meaningful word or phrase

abstract_state: a sequence of shapes with associated labels, where each shape has an ordinal position
abstract_action: access the element at a specific index (the sixth position) and retrieve its value
abstract_next_state: the value at that index, identified as the final solution

abstract_state: a collection of objects with embedded encoded information
abstract_action: identify the encoding scheme, decode the embedded information, and extract the resulting values
abstract_next_state: a list of decoded values corresponding to each object

abstract_state: a collection of labeled items with numeric identifiers
abstract_action: arrange items according to their numeric order in a circular/radial spatial configuration
abstract_next_state: items positioned in a specific geometric pattern where the ordering is represented spatially

abstract_state: a set of phrases and a center piece with multiple other plates/sections
abstract_action: use phrases to establish connections between the center piece and pairs of other plates, where each pair of plates encodes a symbol in a known visual code system
abstract_next_state: a sequence of decoded symbols that spell out a final answer

abstract_state: a set of items with an implicit or explicit ordering constraint
abstract_action: determine the correct sequence in which items must be processed or arranged
abstract_next_state: an ordered list of items following the required sequence

abstract_state: a logic puzzle with constraints and clues describing relationships between entities
abstract_action: solve the constraint satisfaction problem to determine the valid assignment of entities to categories
abstract_next_state: an ordered sequence of entities with their corresponding category assignments

abstract_state: a sequence of symbols in an unfamiliar notation system
abstract_action: decode the notation system to reveal an underlying numeric sequence
abstract_next_state: a numeric ordering that indicates a sequence or priority

abstract_state: a set of items with numerical attributes and a collection of named containers with capacity and value constraints
abstract_action: partition items into containers by matching item attributes against container constraints
abstract_next_state: a mapping of items to their assigned containers based on constraint satisfaction

abstract_state: a partially or fully solved constraint satisfaction problem with multiple variables and their possible values
abstract_action: apply logical deduction and constraint propagation to determine the complete assignment of all variables
abstract_next_state: a fully determined ordering or assignment of all variables that satisfies all constraints

abstract_state: a clue or hint containing idiomatic language or figurative phrases
abstract_action: recognize that a specific phrase is a metaphorical reference to an external system or code
abstract_next_state: identification of the system/code to apply for solving the puzzle

abstract_state: a set of objects with multiple associated paths or trajectories
abstract_action: for each object, combine/overlay its incoming path with its outgoing path to derive a composite value or position
abstract_next_state: a derived set of values obtained from path intersections or composites

abstract_state: a collection of visual paths or trajectories with geometric properties
abstract_action: recognize that the shapes formed by the paths match a known symbolic system (semaphore)
abstract_next_state: a mapping from each shape to its corresponding symbol in the semaphore system

abstract_state: a collection of items each associated with a numeric identifier or sequence number
abstract_action: reorder the items according to their numeric identifiers rather than their discovery or presentation order
abstract_next_state: the items arranged in numeric sequence, revealing a meaningful result

abstract_state: a sequence of visual symbols (semaphore positions)
abstract_action: decode the visual symbols into their corresponding letters
abstract_next_state: a string of letters spelling out a word or phrase

abstract_state: a collection of clues organized in sections
abstract_action: map each clue to a member of a predefined category
abstract_next_state: a list of category members corresponding to the clues

abstract_state: a set of named items and a set of associated visual diagrams with sections
abstract_action: match each named item to its corresponding diagram, then extract a symbol/letter from each section of the diagram
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted symbols/letters corresponding to the sections

abstract_state: multiple sections containing letters
abstract_action: extract all letters from each section and concatenate them
abstract_next_state: a string formed by combining all extracted letters

abstract_state: a visual puzzle containing text and decorative elements with multiple encoding methods applied
abstract_action: identify and decode multiple cipher systems embedded in different parts of the puzzle (borders, annotations, etc.)
abstract_next_state: a collection of decoded messages from each cipher system

abstract_state: encoded text located in a specific structural component
abstract_action: decode the cipher to retrieve the plaintext message
abstract_next_state: a decoded word or phrase

abstract_state: encoded symbols (dots and dashes) associated with a named entity
abstract_action: decode the encoded symbols using a known cipher system
abstract_next_state: a plaintext word extracted from the decoded symbols

abstract_state: dialogue or text containing numerical representations in various formats (dates, numbers, etc.)
abstract_action: identify numerical values in multiple formats, convert them to a common representation (binary), and interpret the result as text or symbols
abstract_next_state: decoded word or message extracted from the numerical conversions

abstract_state: a sequence of text segments (dialogue bubbles) containing words
abstract_action: identify instances of words from a known code system (NATO phonetic alphabet) within each segment, then extract them in sequence
abstract_next_state: a string formed by the decoded words from the code system

abstract_state: a collection of decoded words in no particular order
abstract_action: arrange the words in a logical sequence, then combine them to form an instruction
abstract_next_state: a coherent instruction that specifies the next puzzle operation

abstract_state: a narrative text divided into multiple sections (paragraphs and labeled bubbles)
abstract_action: scan all sections for instances of a specific category (food items) and collect them
abstract_next_state: a categorized list of all items matching the target category, organized by their source location

abstract_state: a list of items with letters at specified positions
abstract_action: extract the letter at position N from each item in the list
abstract_next_state: a string formed by concatenating the extracted letters in order

abstract_state: a collection of individual letters or letter sequences
abstract_action: combine/concatenate the letters in sequence to form a meaningful phrase or word
abstract_next_state: a decoded message or instruction that provides actionable information

abstract_state: puzzle content with contextual clues in flavor text
abstract_action: interpret flavor text to identify the solution method (path-tracing through spatial content produces letters/words)
abstract_next_state: understanding that the solution involves following a trajectory and collecting symbols along that path

abstract_state: a set of clues with missing letters, and a spatial layout (grid/board) where paths can be traced
abstract_action: trace continuous paths through the layout that spell out words matching each clue, with the missing letter being the one that completes the answer
abstract_next_state: identified words that satisfy each clue, with the missing letters extracted

abstract_state: a set of items with gaps or absences
abstract_action: identify the missing elements and collect them in order
abstract_next_state: a sequence of extracted elements forming a meaningful phrase
